description: (Na₂WO₅)₂O₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. The structure consists of four O₂ clusters inside a Na₂WO₅ framework. In each O₂ cluster, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.24 Å. In the Na₂WO₅ framework, there are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.84 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.78 Å. W is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.06 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one W, and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.48 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one W, and one O atom.
